_about: 1,3-Propanediol (1) + Ethanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1,3-propanediol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1,3-propanediol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: H. S. Lai, Y. F. Lin, C. H. Tu, Isobaric (vapor + liquid) equilibria for the ternary system of (ethanol + water + 1,3-propanediol) and three constituent binary systems at P = 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 68 (2014) 13-19
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 13, 14. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0011. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.11 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
